```{r}
fish_afsc <- readRDS("fish_afsc.rds")
fish_pbs <- readRDS("fish_pbs.rds")
fish_nwfsc <- readRDS("fish_nwfsc.rds")
```

```{r}
convert_sex <- function(x) { 
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- dplyr::case_when(
    x == 1 ~ "M",
    x == 2 ~ "F",
    x %in% c("0", "3") ~ "U",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  # set unknown or unexpected values as NA
  )
}
```

```{r}
d1 <- fish_nwfsc |>
  rename(common_name = Common_name, length_cm = Length_cm, weight_kg = Weight_kg, trawl_id = Trawl_id, scientific_name = Scientific_name, sex = Sex) |>
  mutate(region = "nwfsc", survey = "NWFSC.Combo", trawl_id = as.character(trawl_id), year = year(time)) |>
  select(trawl_id, region, common_name, scientific_name, length_cm, weight_kg, sex, survey, time, lon, lat, depth, temp, salinity, o2, phyto, year)

d2 <- fish_pbs |>
  mutate("weight_kg" = weight/1000, sex = convert_sex(sex), year = year(time)) |>
  rename(trawl_id = Trawl_id, common_name = species_common_name, scientific_name = species_science_name, length_cm = length, survey = survey_name) |>
  mutate(region = "pbs", trawl_id = as.character(trawl_id)) |>
  mutate(common_name = case_when(
    common_name == "north pacific spiny dogfish" ~ "pacific spiny dogfish",
    .default = common_name 
  )) |>
  select(trawl_id, region, common_name, scientific_name, length_cm, weight_kg, sex, survey, time, lon, lat, depth, temp, salinity, o2, phyto, year)

d3 <- fish_afsc |>
  rename(trawl_id = Trawl_id, survey = survey_name) |>
  mutate(region = "afsc", trawl_id = as.character(trawl_id), year = year(time)) |>
  mutate(weight_kg = weight_g/1000, length_cm = length_mm/10) |>
  mutate(sex = convert_sex(sex)) |>
  select(trawl_id, region, common_name, scientific_name, length_cm, weight_kg, sex, time, lon, lat, depth, year, survey, temp, salinity, o2, phyto)

fish_all <- bind_rows(d1, d2, d3) |>
  filter(year >= 2003, year <= 2023)
saveRDS(fish_all, "fish_all.rds")
```

```{r}
rm(d1, d2, d3)
```
